original_goal:
[Module: Shopping Cart | TC-005 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Unauthenticated user cannot begin checkout

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{}

Preconditions:
  User is not authenticated (not logged in).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Navigate directly to the Shopping Cart page URL (https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html)
  2. Click the Checkout button

Expected Result:
  Checkout is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page; the checkout flow does not begin; no items are removed or modified.

Notes from prior verification:
  The DOM snapshot used for verification showed an authenticated session and the Checkout button present, so the negative expectation (blocked for unauthenticated users) could not be validated from that snapshot. To execute this test, ensure the session is unauthenticated (log out) before navigating to the cart and attempting Checkout.
expected_outcome: Checkout is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page; the checkout flow does not begin; no items are removed or modified.
